title: Probabilistic reassembly of fragmented streaming payloads for resilient metering
creator: Ava Martinez
summary: Introduce a probabilistic reassembly layer that detects, reconstructs, and attributes token counts for fragmented or out-of-order streaming payloads to reduce orphaned/duplicate charges in high-loss/low-connectivity clients.
background: We observe an uptick in customer tickets where intermittent network conditions and client-side SDK retries produce fragmented or overlapping websocket frames. Existing deterministic checkpointing requires strict ordering and complete fragments which leads to orphaned credits or double-charging when fragments are dropped or replayed.
problem_statement: Current metering pipeline assumes eventual completeness and strict chronological ordering of stream fragments. This fails for: 1) partial fragment loss mid-stream; 2) client replay resulting in duplicate fragments with altered offsets; 3) concurrent multiplexing where fragments from different logical requests are interleaved. Resulting symptoms include incorrect token attribution, late-zeroing credits, and manual refunds.
proposed_solution: Add a lightweight probabilistic reassembly component upstream of final crediting. Key points: 1) fingerprint fragments using rolling-hash + metadata (session id, sequence heuristics); 2) maintain short-lived probabilistic buffers with bloom-filter-like dedupe and best-effort reassembly; 3) scoring function to decide whether to attribute, defer, or mark as provisional credit; 4) emit enriched events for downstream ledger to support later reconciliation and possible retroactive adjustments.
technical_design:
- Fragment fingerprint: 64-bit rolling hash across payload + session token truncated for privacy.
- Buffer TTL: adaptive (100ms-2s) tuned by 95th percentile client RTT.
- Dedupe structure: counting-bloom to handle high throughput with limited memory.
- Scoring: confidence score combining contiguous byte coverage, checksum matches, and sequence continuity. Thresholds: >=0.9 immediate crediting, 0.5-0.9 provisional with auto-finalize after reconciliation window, <0.5 hold and alert.
- Backpressure: if buffer saturation, fall back to existing deterministic path and emit metric 'prob_reassembly_fallback'.
- Privacy: do not persist raw payloads; only store fingerprints and token counts.
api_changes: No public API change. Internal quota/ledger event schema will gain fields: provisional:true|false, reassembly_confidence:float, reassembly_fingerprint:string. Downstream audit viewer will present provisional credits separately.
data_migration_and_reconciliation: Run replay job on 30 days of historical streaming logs to compute candidate reassembly matches and generate retroactive adjustments for accounts with >2% charge discrepancy. Provide opt-in refund sweep for impacted customers and a 'metering-adjustments' dashboard for Finance.
acceptance_criteria:
- Unit/integration tests covering dedupe, scoring thresholds, and TTL expiry.
- End-to-end simulation harness reproducing out-of-order, duplicate, and dropped-fragment scenarios with deterministic outcomes.
- Reduce orphaned charge incidents in synthetic tests by >=95% vs baseline.
- No increase in 99th-percentile billing latency beyond 20ms at p95 load.
- Feature flag gated rollout and ability to disable per-customer.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag behind org-level opt-in in staging. 2) Canary rollout to 5 low-volume enterprise orgs for 48h. 3) Monitor metrics for 7 days, then expand to 20% traffic. 4) Full fleet enabling after 2 weeks and successful reconciliation pass. 5) Run historical reconciliation post full rollout.
qa_test_plan:
- Fuzz harness feeding mixes of tcp drops, websocket reconnects, and duplicate frames.
- Long-duration soak tests to verify buffer memory boundedness.
- Load test at 2x expected production concurrency ensuring counting-bloom false positive rate remains <0.1%.
- Regression tests against existing billing ledger to ensure no double credits.
monitoring_and_alerting: Create dashboards: reassembly_success_rate, provisional_credit_rate, fallback_rate, reassembly_latency_histogram. Alerts: provisional_credit_rate >1% sustained -> PAGE SRE, fallback_rate >0.5% -> WARN SRE, reconciliation_discrepancy >0.1% -> FINANCE alert.
security_considerations: No raw payloads persisted. Fingerprint uses non-reversible hash. Ensure HSM rotation for session salt. Conduct light security review for side-channel leakage in fingerprints.

updates: 2026-03-02: Spike completed; prototype counting-bloom + rolling-hash shows promising 0.04% false-positive in load test.
2026-03-05: Decided to avoid storing raw bytes; switched to truncated SipHash with per-org salt.
2026-03-07: Trade-off discussion: memory vs latency — chosen adaptive TTL to reduce tail latency with small buffer sizes.
2026-03-10: Implemented feature-flag gate and unit tests for dedupe; starting canary signup with 3 customers.
